# Sequence 4: THE JUSTICE LEAGUE ARRIVES

**Duration:** 01:06:12 (1596 frames, 28 shots) · **REC:** 01:02:56:12 - 01:04:03:00 · **Music:** 4M1 'Dawn' (Justice League horn call > strain > arrival fanfare > uneasy strings > merged motif)
